active.summary: AppForge Terminal exits when opened on the real Android device
active.evidence_required: Install the fresh post-merge APK; open AppForge Terminal; verify the relay does not show process code 127; run pwd and echo APPFORGE_OK in the real terminal; confirm no new FATAL EXCEPTION.
active.root_cause: Terminal renderer crash was fixed. The follow-up code-127 failure came from Termux JNI calling execvp(cmd, argv) with '-c' incorrectly placed in argv[0]; the mirror relay now supplies /system/bin/sh as argv[0] before -c.
